sources.entry.cbl:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. ENTRYPOINT.
DATA DIVISION.
WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
01 IN-AMOUNT PIC 9(5) VALUE 4.
01 OUT-AMOUNT PIC 9(5).
01 FINAL-AMOUNT PIC 9(5).
01 FLAG PIC X VALUE 'N'.
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
CALL 'MIDDLE' USING IN-AMOUNT OUT-AMOUNT
IF FLAG = 'Y' MOVE ZERO TO OUT-AMOUNT END-IF
MOVE OUT-AMOUNT TO FINAL-AMOUNT
DISPLAY FINAL-AMOUNT
GOBACK.
sources.middle.cbl:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. MIDDLE.
DATA DIVISION.
LINKAGE SECTION.
01 IN-AMOUNT PIC 9(5).
01 OUT-AMOUNT PIC 9(5).
PROCEDURE DIVISION USING IN-AMOUNT OUT-AMOUNT.
MAIN.
CALL 'LEAF' USING IN-AMOUNT OUT-AMOUNT
GOBACK.
sources.leaf.cbl:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. LEAF.
DATA DIVISION.
LINKAGE SECTION.
01 IN-AMOUNT PIC 9(5).
01 OUT-AMOUNT PIC 9(5).
PROCEDURE DIVISION USING IN-AMOUNT OUT-AMOUNT.
MAIN.
IF IN-AMOUNT > ZERO
COMPUTE OUT-AMOUNT = IN-AMOUNT * 2
ELSE MOVE ZERO TO OUT-AMOUNT END-IF
GOBACK.
